```{r}
# Load necessary library
library(dplyr)

# Read the CSV file
Stroma_final_df_100K <- read.csv("/Users/olsen/Desktop/MMProject/MM_cluster_abundance_per_slide.csv")


# Check the first few rows to verify the structure
head(Stroma_final_df_100K)

```
```{r}
pairwise_results <- Stroma_final_df_100K %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  do({
    control_data <- .[.$Disease_Stage == "Prostate Cancer", "cell_per_100K"]
    other_stages <- unique(.$Disease_Stage[.$Disease_Stage != "Prostate Cancer"])
    
    results <- lapply(other_stages, function(stage) {
      stage_data <- .[.$Disease_Stage == stage, "cell_per_100K"]
      
      if (length(na.omit(control_data$cell_per_100K)) < 1 || 
          length(na.omit(stage_data$cell_per_100K)) < 1) {
        # Log the skipped comparison
        message(paste0("⚠️ Skipping cluster ", unique(.$cluster), 
                       " vs stage ", stage, 
                       " due to insufficient data"))
        return(data.frame(
          cluster = unique(.$cluster),
          stage = stage,
          p_value = NA
        ))
      }
      
      test_result <- wilcox.test(control_data$cell_per_100K, stage_data$cell_per_100K)
      
      data.frame(
        cluster = unique(.$cluster),
        stage = stage,
        p_value = test_result$p.value
      )
    })
    
    do.call(rbind, results)
  })


```


```{r}
pairwise_results <- Stroma_final_df_100K %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  do({
    control_data <- .[.$Disease_Stage == "Prostate Cancer", "cell_per_100K"]
    other_stages <- unique(.$Disease_Stage[.$Disease_Stage != "Prostate Cancer"])
    results <- lapply(other_stages, function(stage) {
      stage_data <- .[.$Disease_Stage == stage, "cell_per_100K"]
      test_result <- wilcox.test(control_data$cell_per_100K, stage_data$cell_per_100K)
      data.frame(
        cluster = unique(.$cluster),
        stage = stage,
        p_value = test_result$p.value
      )
    })
    do.call(rbind, results)
  })

# Adjust p-values for multiple testing using the Benjamini-Hochberg method
pairwise_results$adjusted_p_value <- p.adjust(pairwise_results$p_value, method = "BH")

# Print the results
print(pairwise_results)
```
```{r}
write.csv(pairwise_results, "MM_pairwise_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
install.packages("ggplot2")
install.packages("dplyr")
install.packages("ggsignif")

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggsignif)
```

```{r}
# Merge significance results with the original data
Stroma_final_df_100K <- Stroma_final_df_100K %>%
  left_join(pairwise_results, by = c("cluster", "Disease_Stage" = "stage"))

# Add a column for significance stars where adjusted p-value < 0.05
Stroma_final_df_100K$significance <- ifelse(Stroma_final_df_100K$p_value < 0.05, "*", NA)

# Ensure Disease_Stage is an ordered factor
Stroma_final_df_100K$Disease_Stage <- factor(Stroma_final_df_100K$Disease_Stage, 
                                             levels = c("Prostate Cancer", "MGUS", "SMM", "NDMM", "RRMM"))

bar_heights <- Stroma_final_df_100K %>%
  group_by(Disease_Stage, cluster) %>%
  summarize(mean_cell_per_100K = mean(cell_per_100K, na.rm = TRUE),  # Compute bar height
            significance = ifelse(any(p_value < 0.05), "*", NA), 
            .groups = "drop")

ggplot(Stroma_final_df_100K, aes(x = Disease_Stage, y = cell_per_100K, fill = factor(cluster))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "summary", fun = "mean", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +  # Side-by-side bars
  geom_text(data = bar_heights, 
            aes(x = Disease_Stage, y = mean_cell_per_100K + 5, label = significance, group = cluster), 
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), 
            color = "red", 
            size = 5, 
            na.rm = TRUE) +  # Position stars slightly above bars
  labs(y = "Average Cell Number per 100K cells", x = "Disease Stage", fill = "Cluster") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```
